newsitem.title: USA: OPTIONS-Dlr/yen vols soften Friday but up for week.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-Dlr/yen vols soften Friday but up for week.

text.p: Implied volatility levels on yen options softened a bit on Friday, as the spot rate stabilized around the 121.00 area, several dealers said.

Volatilities on one-month dollar/yen options eased to 12.0/12.3 percent, compared to 12.3/12.6 percent on Thursday, while vols on IMM options on March futures eased to 12.3 percent from 12.4, dealers and floor traders said.
However, they noted that volatilities for yen options remained sharply higher for the week.
One IMM floor analyst said March yen vols were still above their three-year average of 11.3 percent.
